entities.summary: Nestor Alexandrovich Kotlyarevsky was a Russian author, publicist, literary critic and historian. A high-profile scholar and a Russian academy honorary member, Kotlyarevsky taught the history of literature at Moscow University, a series of his lectures served later as a foundation for one of his best known works, The Nineteenth Century (1921). Kotlyarevsky also went down in history as the first director of the Pushkin House (1910).
